en.headline: DFEN is the main reason the portfolio trails VWCE
en.what_happened: The model portfolio rose 0.49% this week, against 0.62% for the benchmark (VWCE). Since 14 August 2026 it returned -0.44% against 1.21%, a shortfall of 1.65 percentage points.
en.why: The largest effect came from DFEN: -1.70 percentage points (weight 12.1%, own return -12.94%). The strongest contribution came from IQQQ: +0.28 percentage points.
